results.title: SimplePractice vs TherapyNotes (2026): Pricing, Features & Reviews Compared
results.snippet: For group telehealth, TherapyNotes’ Premium tier ($15/month) supports up to 16 participants; SimplePractice handles groups within its existing plans; TheraNest covers group sessions on Premier.

results.title: SimplePractice Vs. TherapyNotes: Comparison, Cost, & Key Features
results.snippet: TherapyNotes focuses on streamlined efficiency, while SimplePractice packs in premium features for growing practices. After using both platforms hands-on, we’re breaking down their key differences in features, cost, and overall value. Choose TherapyNotes if you want a structured, easy-to-use EHR with streamlined documentation, built-in telehealth, and e-prescribing, all at a predictable price.
